description:
TYPE: map
TITLE: States That Prohibit Sexual Orientation Discrimination
TEXT IN IMAGE:
State abbreviations: WA, OR, CA, NV, ID, UT, AZ, MT, WY, CO, NM, ND, SD, NE, KS, OK, TX, MN, IA, MO, AR, LA, WI, IL, MI, IN, KY, TN, MS, AL, OH, WV, VA, NC, SC, GA, FL, PA, NY, VT, NH, ME, MA, RI, CT, NJ, DE, MD, DC, AK, HI.
Legend:
- States that prohibit sexual orientation discrimination in both private and public workplaces (orange color)
- States that prohibit sexual orientation discrimination in public workplaces (blue color)
Source: "Sexual Orientation Discrimination in the Workplace." FindLaw. http://employment.findlaw.com/employment-discrimination/sexual-orientation-discrimination-in-the-workplace.html.

DATA:
Orange states (prohibit in both private and public workplaces): WA, OR, CA, NV, CO, NM, MN, IA, IL, WI, ME, VT, MA, RI, CT, NY, NJ, HI.
Blue states (prohibit in public workplaces only): MT, MI, IN, PA.
White states (no color/legend category specified on map for this): ID, UT, AZ, WY, SD, ND, NE, KS, OK, TX, MO, AR, LA, OH, KY, TN, MS, AL, WV, VA, NC, SC, GA, FL, DE, MD, DC, NH, AK.

KEY FACTS:
- The map displays US states categorized by whether they prohibit sexual orientation discrimination in private and public workplaces, public workplaces only, or neither based on the map.
- Orange represents states prohibiting sexual orientation discrimination in both private and public workplaces.
- Blue represents states prohibiting sexual orientation discrimination in public workplaces.
- A significant number of states, particularly in the South and parts of the Midwest and Great Plains, are uncolored (white), indicating no prohibition shown under these categories on the map.
